name: edit-does-not-mint-new-wdk-step-ids
turns: Build a comprehensive kinase strategy for Plasmodium.
Swap the organism on the seed criterion and keep the rest.
rationale: An edit patches the steps it changes and leaves every other WDK step id where it was. A rebuild answers the same request with a new id for every step, which breaks every saved reference to the strategy.

provenance.curatorNote: The step ids are read from the persisted strategy on both sides of the last turn.
